Empowering Business Owners to Delegate their Bookkeeping
Dec 02, 2026 10:00 AM - 11:30 AM

Are you hesitant about outsourcing your bookkeeping? Victoria removes the stigma and worry of handing over your small business finances. She will share actionable tips and suggestions for helping you find the right professional with absolute confidence.

YOUR FACILITATOR:

Victoria Osivnik founded Going Beyond Bookkeeping in 2022, after being a consultant since 2020, to lift the bookkeeping burden off small business owners so they can focus on what they love. By collaborating directly with clients, she actively impacts both their business and their bank accounts. Through strategic outsourcing, Victoria empowers entrepreneurs to reclaim control of their personal lives and win back their precious time.
